parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they share only the structural shape of being zero-field type aliases — not any actual content or domain meaning. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package, Observation layer), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package, two distinct player subsystems), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package, networking layer) each represent distinct domain events in unrelated subsystems. The coincidence is purely structural: every empty-body message type looks identical to the pipeline. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated domain concepts and destroy the semantic clarity that separate named types provide.
